name: Voices of the Void
description: Gather signals from deep space with up to three friends. Multivoid adds drop-in co-op to Voices of the Void: other players, shared props, creatures, events and the signal pipeline.

setup.detail: Voices of the Void is not on Steam: press Locate game... and pick VotV.exe, the one inside the WindowsNoEditor folder.
Download the mod above: Cairn puts it, and the loader it needs, in the game's folder.

hostSteps: Download the mod above, then press Locate game... once and pick VotV.exe from the game's WindowsNoEditor folder.
Press Play. The main menu shows a Multiplayer entry with the Multivoid version.
Choose Multiplayer and host. Your world and save are the session's single source of truth.
Friends join from the server browser or by your address.
joinSteps: Download the mod above, the same version as the host's, locate VotV.exe once and press Play.
In the main menu choose Multiplayer, then pick a lobby or type the host's address.
A join between two different versions is refused with a message saying which side is older.

items.name: Host and join
items.detail: One host and up to three friends, by address or from the server browser. Both sides need the same version of the mod.

items.name: Join at any time
items.detail: A player who connects receives the host's whole world, even in the middle of an event.

items.name: Kept up to date
items.detail: Cairn installs the mod and its loader in the game's folder and updates them when a new version is released.

items.name: Other players
items.detail: Bodies, footsteps, name plates, text chat and positional voice chat.

items.name: The shared world
items.detail: Props, creatures, events, weather, doors and the signal-processing pipeline are kept in step.
